content.name: Validate batch records before storage · deterministic fixture
content.notes: Bundled fixture plan. No model has run; no approval or execution permission is included.

brief.requirements: Each input row is a dictionary. Save records with a non-empty string identifier exactly once, skip absent, empty or whitespace identifiers, and continue after these invalid dictionaries. Handling non-dictionary rows is out of scope.
brief.constraints: Use a disposable repository. No provider calls.
brief.outOfScope: Real AI performance, human review timing and production deployment.
brief.decisions: Keep validation before the storage callback. Counting successful saves is a separate dependent task.
